Hollis is the Central team lead, so a draft to him with the rate in it needs sign-off from June Osei-Lark or Anselm Grieve first. Even as a draft, I can't create it until one of them approves. I've logged an approval request with June (deal desk). Could you ping her, or Anselm, to approve it here?

Once one of them does, I'll save this draft in your mailbox:

To: Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com)
Subject: Quarrendon 2027 rate

Hi Hollis,

For the territory review: Quarrendon Freight Lines' proposed 2027 rate is $2,356 per seat. That's from my call with them yesterday and isn't in any document yet.

Thanks,

I will be on the road tomorrow morning, reachable on mobile.
